high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque garden scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset. The sky is filled with a mix of clouds, some illuminated by the sun, creating a dramatic and beautiful backdrop. The sun is partially visible on the right side of the image, casting a warm glow that contrasts with the cooler tones of the clouds. The garden itself features a long, rectangular reflecting pool in the foreground. The water in the pool is calm, reflecting the sky above and the surrounding greenery.
